text:
Pearls are typically found in oysters, clams, mussels, and other bivalve mollusks.

The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic beats and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. Just as these mollusks layer nacre around irritants to create pearls, the city layers experiences, noise, and movement to form its unique cultural gems. The rhythmic pulse of the hip-hop soundtrack mirrors the heartbeat of the metropolis, transforming the raw, abrasive elements of urban existence into something refined and valuable, much like the lustrous beauty emerging from the depths of the sea.
